# The planet: a radius 1.4 m low-poly sphere (icosphere, 2 subdivisions, jittered), berry rock with two
# mauve seas, rock spires between the house sites. The back half (never seen by the
# face-on camera) is deleted. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.310 0.078 0.275 --no-slot
material new Sea --base-color 0.431 0.318 0.506 --no-slot
material new Spire --base-color 0.431 0.318 0.506 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Planet --radius 1.4 --subdivisions 2 --location 0 0 0
material assign Rock
mode edit
select vert where "true"
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 3
select face where "pos.y > 0.45"
delete only-faces
select face where "sqrt((pos.x+0.55)*(pos.x+0.55) + (pos.y+1.1)*(pos.y+1.1) + (pos.z-0.45)*(pos.z-0.45)) < 0.62"
select face where "sqrt((pos.x-0.75)*(pos.x-0.75) + (pos.y+0.95)*(pos.y+0.95) + (pos.z+0.6)*(pos.z+0.6)) < 0.5" --extend
material assign Sea
mode object

add mesh cone --name Spire0 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
apply --location
set rotation 0 0.00 0
set location 0.000 -0.150 1.320
material assign Spire
add mesh cone --name Spire1 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
apply --location
set rotation 0 -90.00 0
set location -1.320 -0.150 0.000
material assign Spire
add mesh cone --name Spire2 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
apply --location
set rotation 0 -180.00 0
set location -0.000 -0.150 -1.320
material assign Spire
add mesh cone --name Spire3 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
apply --location
set rotation 0 90.00 0
set location 1.320 -0.150 0.000
material assign Spire
add mesh cone --name Spire4 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0 --depth 0.32 --location 0 0 0.16
apply --location
set rotation 0 70.00 0
set location 1.240 -0.150 0.451
material assign Spire
add mesh cone --name Spire5 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0 --depth 0.32 --location 0 0 0.16
apply --location
set rotation 0 -70.00 0
set location -1.240 -0.150 0.451
material assign Spire
select all
shade flat
export planet.glb
